text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: AUTH_JWT_VALIDATION_FAILURE (PD-12345). Service: hosted-api-auth. Estimated impacted traffic: 7% of token validations. Paging on-call SRE.

pagerduty: PD-12345 triggered at 2026-03-14T03:12:01Z — escalation policy: SRE Oncall.

sre_dan: acked on-call (sre_dan) — looking. :eyes:

incident-bot: auto-collecting: /var/log/auth/*.log (rolling 1h), sampling traces from request-id header.

sre_dan: quick summary — auth service returning 401s for a subset of tokens. Error in logs: `jwt: signature verification failed: kid mismatch`. Appears after a key rotation job ran ~03:10 UTC.

auth_kira: I saw the rotation job finish at 03:09 and it pushed a new key to the signing cluster. The JWKS endpoint update to CDN might be delayed. Checking key-sync worker.

eng_omar: adding context — we rolled a new signing key yesterday for planned rotation. New key id is `k_2026_03_14_v2`. Old key `k_2026_03_13_v1` should still verify until ttl. If clients send tokens signed with v1 but verifier only has v2, mismatch occurs.

product_support_lee: any external customers reporting errors yet? Support queue shows a spike in 500/401 for API clients in EU region. One ticket from acme-inc reports login failures since ~03:15.

customer_ops_ana: tagging customer ops — Acme, BetaCorp, and two internal staging clusters. Impact: authentication step failing, downstream requests returning 401, some background jobs retrying. Preliminary impact: auth flows fail for ~5–9% of users hitting the hosted API.

sre_dan: mitigation options I see: 1) roll back rotation (re-add v1 to signers/verifiers), 2) make verifier accept multiple keys (enable permissive mode), 3) re-run key-sync to push v1 into verifier caches/CDN. Fastest is re-populating the JWKS used by verifiers.

auth_kira: confirming — key-sync worker shows a failed upload to CDN edge at 03:11 with 504 from cdn-upload endpoint. The signing service did push the jwk to internal storage. CDN propagation failed so many verifiers pulled only new JWKS (v2) or cached an incomplete set.

eng_omar: can we force CDN invalidation and push complete JWKS? I can run `scripts/jwks_push --force --src=internal/jwks/all.json`. Will that help verifiers within seconds?

sre_dan: do it. If CDN is flaky, fallback is to update verifier configs to read directly from internal storage until CDN is healthy. That avoids waiting for global propagation.

eng_omar: running: ```bash
# pushing full jwks bundle
./scripts/jwks_push --force --src=internal/jwks/all.json --dst=cdn://redwood/jwks.json
```

incident-bot: deploy-bot: start deploy job 8854 (jwks push) triggered by eng_omar.

eng_omar: CDN push returned 200 for primary edge but a few edges still 502. Kicking TTL invalidate: `cdnctl purge /jwks.json --fast`

auth_kira: while that runs, I'm going to enable verifier fallback to internal store on all auth verifier nodes to accept both v1 and v2 keys. This is a config flip — no restart. Patch is `auth.verifier.allow_fallback=true` pushed to config service.

sre_dan: patch applied to verifier config service. Verifier nodes pick up config within ~30s. Monitoring for reduced 401s.

product_support_lee: support queue note: please advise customers to retry. Sending broadcast to impacted customers via status.redwood.ai (drafting).

customer_ops_ana: suggested customer-facing blurb: "We experienced an authentication issue due to a key rotation propagation failure. We are mitigating and tokens should resume validation shortly. If you continue to see failures, email support@redwood.com with example request IDs." Approving to post.

eng_omar: CDN purges completed 03:22 UTC. All edges returned 200 on recheck. Verifier fallback already active.

sre_dan: metrics check — token validation 401 rate dropped from 8.7% to 0.6% in the last 3 minutes. Error traces show `kid mismatch` logs diminishing.

auth_kira: I'm going to re-run key-sync to ensure all nodes have full jwks set and mark the rotation job as succeeded. `key-sync --ensure-all --retry=3` started.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-12345 — acknowledged by sre_dan, status: in_progress.

eng_omar: re-run finished, all nodes report both keys present. Leaving fallback enabled for 10 more minutes then we'll revert to strict mode.

sre_dan: can someone leave a note for post-incident: ensure jwks push has a retry/backoff on CDN failures and add a canary validation step that fetches jwks from CDN and verifies expected kid list before marking rotation complete.

auth_kira: noted. I'll open a follow-up RFC for rotation safety improvements and include a runbook step to monitor CDN responses.

product_support_lee: posted status update to status.redwood.ai and sent proactive emails to 3 impacted customers.

customer_ops_ana: monitoring customer tickets for re-opens. So far only 2 follow-ups, both resolved after retry. No P0 customer-impact claims yet.

sre_dan: on-call handoff in 45m. I'll keep watch for 15 more minutes then hand to next oncall. Current incident state: mitigated, monitoring. I'll set PD to resolved after we confirm stable for 30m.

eng_omar: small note — logs show one client sending tokens with old `kid` but expired tokens too; those should still be 401 but not related to rotation. Filtering those from incident metrics.

auth_kira: follow-up tasks I'll own: 1) add CDN push retries, 2) add pre-rotation canary check, 3) update runbook with fallback toggle. Will file tasks and link PRs.

sre_dan: thanks all. Marking this thread for postmortem if PD escalates. For now: PD-12345 will remain open until 04:12 UTC for observation. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-12345 status updated: monitoring.

sre_dan: last check — 401 spike fully recovered, traffic normalized. I'll handoff at 03:57 UTC. If anything bubbles up, re-alert.

product_support_lee: closing the reactive support batch, leaving one follow-up email to Acme.

customer_ops_ana: ack.

incident-bot: PD-12345 resolved at 04:22:01Z (status changed to resolved by sre_dan). Incident timeline captured to incident service.

sre_dan: filing brief incident note and adding measured impact numbers: ~7% token validations impacted briefly, ~15 minutes of elevated 401s for certain clients, no data compromise. Follow-up RFC and runbook PRs will be referenced in postmortem.

auth_kira: will prepare technical write-up for postmortem.

eng_omar: thumbs up.

product_support_lee: thumbs up from support.

sre_dan: thanks team. Closing thread.
